title: The Plate Door
blurb: Lady Vivienne's pearls sit on the study desk. The study door only opens while someone stands on the brass plate.
goal: Take the pearls out over the balcony

tips.1: Next round, your echo will do exactly what you just did. Let it hold the plate.
tips.*: Stand on the plate, then end the round with ⟲. Your echo keeps standing there.
